widgets_values:
A complete **Krea 2 Film Studio** generation node built inside ComfyUI, designed to keep the entire image workflow inside one clean interface. It supports **Text-to-Image, Image-to-Image, Directed Control, custom resolutions, megapixel scaling, sampler settings, seeds, LoRA loading, prompt history, gallery, autosave, and model settings**, while still outputting a standard ComfyUI **IMAGE, LATENT, and used seed** for use with other nodes.

The goal is to make Krea 2 feel like a standalone creative studio while keeping everything fully local and integrated with ComfyUI.

1MP For 720
2MP For 1080

{"version":1,"mode":"t2i","preset":"Fast","prompt":"A hyper-realistic cinematic Iron Man flight movie still matching the same forward-flying pose, but with much stronger cinematic depth, atmosphere, and large-format blockbuster photography. Iron Man is flying directly toward the camera at high speed, body angled slightly downward, arms extended outward and slightly back for stability, palms open, shoulders squared, head facing forward with a focused, aggressive flight posture.

His red-and-gold armor is highly detailed and battle-worn, with realistic brushed metal, fine scratches, scorched edges, tiny dents, panel seams, mechanical joints, exposed micro-components, and subtle heat discoloration around the repulsor systems. The eye slits glow bright cool white-blue, while the arc reactor in his chest burns with a concentrated white-cyan light. Keep the armor physically heavy and engineered, not glossy plastic.

The camera is positioned slightly below and ahead of Iron Man, flying backward at nearly matching speed, creating the feeling that he is charging straight through the lens. His upper torso and helmet dominate the frame, while the arms extend toward the edges, giving a powerful triangular composition.

Below him is a huge landscape seen from high altitude: patchwork farmland, winding roads, distant towns, river channels, hills, and small industrial areas rendered with strong aerial perspective. Large cloud banks and wisps of vapor pass between camera and ground, creating multiple depth layers. The land below should feel far away and slightly softened by haze rather than flat and game-like.

Iron Man breaks through a layer of thin clouds, with condensation vapor curling around his shoulders, arms, and lower body. Faint contrails and disturbed air stream backward from his flight path. Tiny particles and moisture streak past the camera to enhance speed.

Use dramatic side lighting from the sun, positioned high behind camera-left, creating warm highlights along the gold faceplate and red shoulder armor while the opposite side falls into cooler shadow. The polished armor reflects soft sky tones, cloud highlights, and pieces of the landscape below.

Camera: ARRI Alexa 65 / IMAX-style large-format digital cinema look, 32mm anamorphic lens, low front three-quarter aerial tracking shot, camera moving backward at matching velocity, medium close-wide framing, subtle wide-angle perspective, realistic aerodynamic vibration, controlled motion blur in the background while Iron Man remains sharp.

Depth of field: Iron Man razor sharp from helmet to chest, arms slightly softer toward the extreme edges, distant terrain heavily softened by atmospheric perspective, passing cloud layers partially defocused near the lens.

Lighting: bright natural daylight above cloud level, warm directional sunlight, cool blue skylight fill, realistic metallic reflections, bright but restrained eye and arc-reactor emissive glow, soft volumetric scattering in clouds.

Color grade: deep metallic crimson, muted brushed gold, cool cyan-white energy lights, natural blue-gray sky, subdued green and tan landscape below, rich cinematic contrast, soft highlight roll-off, restrained saturation, subtle Kodak-style film grain and halation.

Mood: fast, powerful, heroic, urgent, high-altitude, blockbuster scale.
